ei.subject: 수능특강Light 영어
ei.title: On the boat, water stretched to every horizon.

fullPassage: On the boat, water stretched to every horizon. Ann Marie did a final check of her scuba gear, and then dropped into the sea with the other divers. Several minutes into the dive, a metallic clang interrupted the quiet. One of the divemasters knocked on her tank to get everyone's attention. She pointed to a grayish blur forming in the distance. A shadowy fin emerged, and then Ann Marie saw a uniquely shaped head followed by a powerful, streamlined body. The unmistakable rectangular feature made it easy to identify the enormous creature swimming nearby. It was a great hammerhead shark. In a moment, another shadow joined the first and then another. Soon, dozens of hammerheads glided effortlessly past the divers. It was astonishing and beautiful. Ann Marie wished there was a way to make the moment last.

questions.passage: On the boat, water (A)[stretched / shrank] to every horizon. Ann Marie did a final check of her scuba gear, and then (B)[dropped / flew] into the sea with the other divers. Several minutes into the dive, a metallic clang (C)[continued / interrupted] the quiet. One of the divemasters knocked on her tank to get everyone's attention. She pointed to a grayish blur forming in the distance. A shadowy fin emerged, and then Ann Marie saw a uniquely shaped head followed by a powerful, streamlined body. The unmistakable rectangular feature made it easy to identify the enormous creature swimming nearby. It was a great hammerhead shark. In a moment, another shadow joined the first and then another. Soon, dozens of hammerheads glided effortlessly past the divers. It was astonishing and beautiful. Ann Marie wished there was a way to make the moment last.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 펼쳐졌다(stretched), 뛰어들었다(dropped), 방해했다(interrupted).
det.analysis:
✅ ① stretched — dropped — interrupted: 물이 수평선까지 '펼쳐지고', 바다로 '뛰어들었으며', 금속성 소리가 고요를 '방해했다'는 문맥에 적합.
❌ ② shrank — dropped — interrupted: shrank(줄어들었다)는 수평선까지 펼쳐짐과 반대.
❌ ③ stretched — flew — interrupted: flew(날았다)는 바다로 떨어지는 것과 다름.
❌ ④ stretched — dropped — continued: continued(계속되었다)는 고요를 '방해하다'와 반대.
det.tip: stretch ↔ shrink, drop(뛰어들다), interrupt ↔ continue

questions.passage: On the boat, water stretched to every horizon. Ann Marie did a final check of her scuba gear, and then dropped into the sea with the other divers. Several minutes into the dive, a metallic clang interrupted the quiet. One of the divemasters knocked on her tank to get everyone's attention. She pointed to a (A)[bright / grayish] blur forming in the distance. A shadowy fin (B)[emerged / disappeared], and then Ann Marie saw a uniquely shaped head followed by a powerful, (C)[streamlined / clumsy] body. The unmistakable rectangular feature made it easy to identify the enormous creature swimming nearby. It was a great hammerhead shark. In a moment, another shadow joined the first and then another. Soon, dozens of hammerheads glided effortlessly past the divers. It was astonishing and beautiful. Ann Marie wished there was a way to make the moment last.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 회색빛(grayish), 나타났다(emerged), 유선형의(streamlined).
det.analysis:
✅ ③ grayish — emerged — streamlined: '회색빛' 형체가 멀리서 나타나고, 지느러미가 '나타났으며', '유선형' 몸체가 뒤따랐다는 문맥에 적합.
❌ ① bright — emerged — streamlined: bright(밝은)는 어두운 형체(shadowy)와 맞지 않음.
❌ ② grayish — disappeared — streamlined: disappeared(사라졌다)는 'emerged'와 반대.
❌ ④ grayish — emerged — clumsy: clumsy(서투른)는 강력한 상어 묘사와 반대.
det.tip: grayish = 회색빛의, emerge ↔ disappear, streamlined = 유선형의

The unmistakable rectangular feature made it easy to (A)[identify / confuse] the enormous creature swimming nearby. It was a great hammerhead shark. In a moment, another shadow joined the first and then another. Soon, dozens of hammerheads glided (B)[awkwardly / effortlessly] past the divers. It was (C)[disappointing / astonishing] and beautiful. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 식별하다(identify), 손쉽게(effortlessly), 놀라운(astonishing).
det.analysis:
✅ ② identify — effortlessly — astonishing: '식별하다', '손쉽게 미끄러지다', '놀랍고' 아름답다는 문맥에 적합.
❌ ① confuse — effortlessly — astonishing: confuse(혼동하다)는 'unmistakable'과 반대.
❌ ③ identify — awkwardly — astonishing: awkwardly(어색하게)는 상어의 유연한 움직임과 반대.
❌ ④ identify — effortlessly — disappointing: disappointing(실망스러운)은 beautiful과 반대.
det.tip: identify ↔ confuse, effortlessly ↔ awkwardly, astonishing ↔ disappointing

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① pleased(기쁘게 했다) → interrupted(방해했다). 금속성 소리가 고요를 '방해했다'가 원문.
det.analysis:
❌ ① pleased → interrupted: interrupted the quiet(고요를 방해했다)가 원문.
✅ ② tank: 산소통 → 적절
✅ ③ attention: 주의 → 적절
✅ ④ distance: 거리(멀리서) → 적절
det.tip: interrupt the quiet = 고요를 방해하다. ↔ please(기쁘게 하다)

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ unclear(불분명한) → unmistakable(명확한). 직사각형 특징이 '명확해서' 쉽게 식별되었다는 문맥.
det.analysis:
✅ ① in the distance: 멀리서 → 적절
✅ ② emerged: 나타났다 → 적절
❌ ③ unclear → unmistakable: unmistakable(명확한)이 원문. 'made it easy to identify'(쉽게 식별하게 했다)와 연결.
✅ ④ hammerhead: 귀상어 → 적절
det.tip: unmistakable(명확한) ↔ unclear(불분명한). easy to identify = 쉽게 식별

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② awkwardly(서투르게) → effortlessly(손쉽게). 유선형 귀상어들이 '손쉽게' 미끄러지듯 지나갔다가 원문.
det.analysis:
✅ ① joined: 합류했다 → 적절
❌ ② awkwardly → effortlessly: glided effortlessly past(손쉽게 미끄러지듯 지나갔다)가 원문. awkwardly(서투르게)는 유선형 동물의 움직임과 반대.
✅ ③ astonishing: 놀라운 → 적절
✅ ④ last: 지속되다 → 적절
det.tip: effortlessly(손쉽게) ↔ awkwardly(서투르게). 유선형 동물의 부드러운 움직임

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 (A)와 (B)의 feature의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) 특징 (B) 특집 기사.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ (A) 특징 — (B) 특집 기사: (A)에서 feature는 '특징'(명사), (B)에서 feature는 '특집 기사'(명사).
❌ ① (A) 특집 — (B) 특징: 반대 배치
❌ ② (A) 얼굴 — (B) 특집 기사: (A)에서 feature는 신체 특징 아님
❌ ③ (A) 특징 — (B) 영화: (B)에서 feature는 신문 기사 맥락
det.tip: feature: 특징, 특색 / 특집 기사 / 영화 장편 - 문맥에 따라 다양

questions.stem:

"to move smoothly, quietly, and without effort"

det.analysis:
✅ ④ glide: 미끄러지듯 움직이다 — 부드럽고 노력 없이 움직이는 것.
❌ ① stumble: 비틀거리다 — 반대
❌ ② crash: 충돌하다 — 무관
❌ ③ jump: 뛰다 — 부드러움과 다름
det.tip: glide = 미끄러지듯 움직이다. 유선형 동물/비행기의 움직임

det.korean: forming. 명사 'a grayish blur'를 수식하는 현재분사. 흐릿한 형체가 '형성되고 있는' 능동 진행.
det.analysis: form → forming. 현재분사로 명사 수식 (능동/진행).
det.tip: 현재분사 수식: 명사 + V-ing = 능동 진행

questions.passage: A shadowy fin emerged. Ann Marie saw a uniquely shaped head __________ (follow) by a powerful, streamlined body. It was a great hammerhead shark.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (1단어) (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.korean: followed. 명사 'head'를 수식하는 과거분사. '뒤따라지는' 수동의 관계.
det.analysis: follow → followed. 과거분사로 명사 수식 (수동). a head followed by ~ = ~에 의해 뒤따라지는 머리.
det.tip: 과거분사 수식: 명사 + p.p. = 수동 관계

questions.passage: On the boat, water stretched to every horizon. Ann Marie did a final check of her scuba gear, and then dropped into the sea with the other divers. Several minutes into the dive, a metallic clang ____. One of the divemasters knocked on her tank to get everyone's attention. She pointed to a grayish blur forming in the distance. A shadowy fin emerged, and then Ann Marie saw a uniquely shaped head followed by a powerful, streamlined body. The unmistakable rectangular feature made it easy to identify the enormous creature swimming nearby. It was a great hammerhead shark. In a moment, another shadow joined the first and then another. Soon, dozens of hammerheads glided effortlessly past the divers. It was astonishing and beautiful. Ann Marie wished there was a way to make the moment last.
questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: interrupted the quiet = 고요를 방해했다. 다이빙 중 금속성 소리가 고요를 깬다는 문맥.
det.analysis:
✅ ② interrupted the quiet: 고요를 방해했다 — metallic clang이 고요한 다이빙 분위기를 방해함.
❌ ① continued peacefully: 평화롭게 계속되었다 — 반대
❌ ③ echoed through space: 공간을 울렸다 — 문맥 불명확
❌ ④ brought total silence: 완전한 침묵을 가져왔다 — 반대
det.tip: interrupt the quiet = 고요를 방해하다 (소리로 인해)

questions.passage: On the boat, water stretched to every horizon. Ann Marie did a final check of her scuba gear, and then dropped into the sea with the other divers. Several minutes into the dive, a metallic clang interrupted the quiet. One of the divemasters knocked on her tank to get everyone's attention. She pointed to a grayish blur forming in the distance. A shadowy fin emerged, and then Ann Marie saw a uniquely shaped head followed by a powerful, streamlined body. The unmistakable rectangular feature made it easy to identify the enormous creature swimming nearby. It was a great hammerhead shark. In a moment, another shadow joined the first and then another. Soon, dozens of hammerheads glided effortlessly past the divers. It was astonishing and beautiful. Ann Marie wished there ____ make the moment last.
questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: was a way to = ~할 방법이 있기를. 'she wished there was a way to make the moment last'는 '그 순간을 지속시킬 방법이 있기를 바랐다'.
det.analysis:
✅ ① was a way to: ~할 방법이 있기를 — wished there was a way to V ~하기를 바람.
❌ ② is the solution for: 시제 어색 (과거)
❌ ③ had been tools for: 문맥 이상
❌ ④ could be reasons for: 이유는 맞지 않음
det.tip: wish there was/were = ~이 있기를 바라다 (가정법 과거)
